Win11._comment: Windows 11 STIG — VDI-specific Not Applicable findings
Win11.V-REPLACE_BitLocker_OS: BitLocker full-volume encryption of the OS drive is not applicable to non-persistent VDI desktops. The hypervisor (VMware ESXi / Omnissa Horizon) enforces encryption of all datastore extents at rest via VMcrypt or vSAN Encryption per site security architecture. Reference: VDI Gold Image Security Plan, Section 4.2.
Win11.V-REPLACE_BitLocker_Fixed: BitLocker encryption of fixed data drives is not applicable to non-persistent pooled VDI desktops. No persistent user data is stored on local drives; all user data resides in FSLogix profile containers on encrypted network storage. Reference: VDI Gold Image Security Plan, Section 4.2.
Win11.V-REPLACE_WindowsHello: Windows Hello for Business is not applicable in this environment. CAC/PIV Smart Card is the sole approved primary authentication method per DoD policy. Windows Hello PIN is explicitly disabled via Group Policy to prevent PIN-based bypass of Smart Card requirement.
Win11.V-REPLACE_StandaloneRisk: This requirement is not applicable to non-persistent pooled VDI desktops. These systems are managed through Omnissa Horizon Connection Server and do not function as standalone endpoints. Risk is accepted and documented in the System Security Plan.
Win11.V-REPLACE_GuestAccount: The built-in Guest account requirement is not applicable. The Guest account is disabled and locked via Group Policy at the domain level for all VDI desktops in the pool.
Win11.V-REPLACE_RecoveryConsole: Recovery console configuration is not applicable to non-persistent VDI desktops. In the event of a failure, the affected desktop is deleted from the pool and a new instance is provisioned from the sealed gold image.

Chrome.V-REPLACE_ExtensionAllowlist: Chrome extension allowlist is managed via Group Policy ADMX. The approved enterprise extension list is configured in GPO 'VDI-Chrome-Hardening' and enforced at the domain level. Individual registry-level configuration is not applicable.
Chrome.V-REPLACE_DefaultSearchProvider: Default search provider name and URL are configured via Group Policy to the organization-approved search endpoint. Local registry configuration is not applicable as GPO takes precedence.

MSOffice365.V-REPLACE_CloudSave: OneDrive cloud save prompts are managed by the FSLogix profile container. User profile data is stored in ODFC containers on-premises. Cloud save to personal OneDrive is blocked at the network level via Tenant Restrictions policy.

WinFirewall.V-REPLACE_DomainProfile: Windows Firewall domain profile inbound rules are managed via Group Policy. Domain-joined VDI desktops receive firewall policy from 'VDI-Firewall-Hardening' GPO. Local rule configuration is not applicable.
